content: What's a good exercise for my upper chest?

Upper chest? Incline barbell bench press and incline dumbbell press are the kings for that - they hit the clavicular head harder than flat pressing. Low-to-high cable flyes work too if you want isolation.

What angle and equipment you got available? 💪
Sounds good, add it to today's workout.
